metadata.description: Your AI nods along. These skills don't. Skills for product owners – in Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT, in the language you write in.

plugins.name: product-coach
plugins.description: Socratic product coach in the style of the Silicon Valley Product Group (Marty Cagan). Honest feedback both ways – headwind when you're off, tailwind when you're right: sharpens product judgment, product sense and discovery discipline. Four modes: Situation, Skill-Building, Critique, Context-Sharpening. Comes with templates for strategic context, current themes, reference frameworks and a coaching log. Answers in the language you write in – English, German, French and more.
